description: Closing odds for every settled event across up to 10 leagues in one request, for closing line value (CLV) and model backtests. Date range up to 366 days, so a season fits in one sweep; at most 100 events per response, page with limit and skip. Paid plans. Each event is shaped like get_historical_odds.

to.description: End date in RFC3339 format, at most 366 days after from

name: get_closing_lines
title: Closing lines
